scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation Of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
other_conditions: Enterprise must be unincorporated and employ fewer than 10 workers
Applicant must own the enterprise (proprietary or partnership firm)
Only one person per family (self, spouse, children) is eligible for financial assistance
Applicant must be at least 18 years old and have at least VIII standard education
Project cost cannot include land cost; lease/rental workshed can be included for a maximum of 3 years
Co‑operatives/FPOs must have a minimum turnover of Rs 1 crore and the project cost must not exceed their turnover
Co‑operatives/FPOs must have members with a minimum of 3 years experience in the product and must provide 10 % of project cost as margin money
SHG members must be presently engaged in food processing and must commit the seed capital for working capital and small tools
SHG members must have a minimum of 3 years experience in processing the ODOP product for branding/marketing support
Branding and marketing assistance requires a minimum product turnover of Rs 5 crore
Applicants must contribute at least 10 % of the project cost, with the balance to be financed through a bank loan
benefits_summary: Provides credit‑linked capital subsidy (up to 35% of project cost, maximum ₹10 lakh) and related grants for micro food processing enterprises, SHGs, FPOs, along with branding, marketing and common infrastructure support.
